messages:
maria: Quick kickoff — we need a focused landing page pass that covers Hosted API, Dedicated, and Private. Goal: one unified hero that routes visitors into three clear activation paths (self-serve / reserved / private-deploy), plus a short benchmark narrative, webinar promo slot, and inbound lead routing rules. Timeline: rough draft by Tue EOD.

sam: OK. I can mock 3 hero variants — one product-led (Hosted), one value-led (Dedicated predictability), one compliance-led (Private). Will do short 1-line hooks + 3 bullet substantiation each.

jon: For the benchmark narrative, let's keep it simple: pick 2 metrics that matter to engineers/plat teams — p99 latency (ms) and cost per 1M tokens. We should call out sample workload (chat v. batch). Need Lee to confirm numbers we can publish.

lee: I have internal numbers from last quarter for our p99 and cost curves. I'll sanitize and hand over a short 2-sentence benchmark blurb. Also adding suggested inbound routing rules here — small companies self-serve, >250 employees -> SDR, >1000 or compliance checkbox -> AE/Enterprise.

sam: Draft hero options here (very rough):
```
Variant A (Hosted): "Build with predictable LLM inference — fast API, transparent pricing."
CTA1: "Try Hosted API"  CTA2: "See benchmarks"

Variant B (Dedicated): "Reserve throughput, reduce variability — Dedicated capacity for steady production."
CTA1: "Get dedicated pricing"  CTA2: "Watch demo"

Variant C (Private): "Deploy inference behind your VPC — control, keys, and audit logs."
CTA1: "Talk to sales"  CTA2: "Schedule a security review"
```

sam: Also a few short bullets to accompany hero (one-liners):
- High-throughput runtime tuned for modern LLMs
- Smart routing and auto-fallback to keep apps online
- Cost controls: batching, caching, quantization suggestions

maria: Love the variants. For the page we're aiming to present a single hero that personalizes copy based on a toggle / query param. We should show the three CTAs visually but promote the one matching the visitor. Also need a 40–60 word narrative that ties benchmarking to real customer outcomes (latency -> UX, cost -> unit economics).

jon: Webinar: propose a 45-min live: "Serving at scale: choosing between Hosted, Dedicated, and Private" — short benchmark demo + 10-min customer panel. Date suggestion: two weeks out. Can calendar-bot attempt a draft schedule? @calendar-bot could you propose 3 slots?

calendar-bot: Proposed times: Thu Apr 18 11:00AM PT, Tue Apr 23 9:00AM PT, Wed Apr 24 4:00PM PT — internal availability unknown. Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/serve-scale-demo

lee: Routing rule (very rough) — we should wire this to inbound form + marketing qualified lead (MQL) scoring. Example YAML for engineering to hand to Growth Ops: 
```yaml
lead_routing:
  - if: "company_size <= 50"
    route: "self-serve"
  - if: "company_size > 50 and company_size <= 250"
    route: "SDR"
  - if: "company_size > 250 or compliance_required == true"
    route: "AE-enterprise"
  - default: "self-serve"
```

sam: Nice. For the website module we should include a compact benchmark card with two datapoints + methodology tooltip. Example copy: "p99: 120ms on chat (gpt-like model) • $X per 1M tokens (inference only). See details ->"

maria: Assignments: Sam = hero variants + bullets + benchmark card layout. Lee = sanitized numbers + routing YAML + compliance blurb. Jon = webinar logistics and recording plan. I'll assemble a copy deck and get design to wire the hero personalization toggle. Deliverables due Tue EOD for review.

jon: Quick QA — can we avoid absolute pricing numbers unless cleared by finance? For public benchmarks, prefer percent improvements or ranges if pricing is sensitive.

lee: Good call. I'll provide ranges and percentage deltas vs typical open-source baseline.

sam: I'll draft 2 hero-level A/B tests: (1) performance-first vs (2) economics-first. Keep CTAs consistent.

maria: Perfect. If anyone finds relevant customer quotes (short, <20 words) that map to each mode, drop them here. Also flag any security claims for Legal review. :thumbsup:

jon: I'll ping solutions engineering for a 20–30s clip for the webinar demo.

calendar-bot: Webinar slot confirmed provisional: Tue Apr 23 9:00AM PT (pending host availability).

maria: Thanks team — I'll post the copy deck link when ready and set a brief review on Tue morning.
